title: Robust bounds for American fixed-strike lookback puts
abstract: arXiv:2611.30980v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We initiate the robust (model-independent) pricing of American lookback options under martingale optimal transport (MOT) constraints. Given finitely many marginals of the discounted price, we study the maximal expected discounted payoff of an American fixed-strike lookback put, whose exercise value at $t$ is $(K-\min_{u\le t}e^{ru}X_u)^+$, i.e.\ a function of the running minimum $m_t$ of the undiscounted price. Two structural facts isolate this as the non-trivial American lookback problem: at $r=0$ every classical lookback degenerates to its European counterpart, while at $r>0$ the max-based fixed-strike lookback call remains European-type, but the min-based put is genuinely American. We prove a pricing--hedging duality using the continuous-time duality of Guo--Ob\l{}oj and reducing the hedge to the two-dimensional state $(X_t,m_t)$. translated_title: 美式固定执行价回望看跌期权的稳健边界
translated_abstract: 我们在鞅最优传输约束下开创了美式回望期权的稳健（模型无关）定价研究。给定贴现价格的有限多个边际分布，我们研究美式固定执行价回望看跌期权的最大期望贴现收益，其在时刻 t 的行权价值为 (K − min_{u≤t} e^{ru} X_u)⁺，即未贴现价格的运行最小值 m_t 的函数。两个结构性事实表明这是非平凡的美式回望问题：当 r=0 时，每个经典回望期权退化为其欧式对应版本；而当 r>0 时，基于最大值的固定执行价回望看涨期权仍是欧式类型，但基于最小值的看跌期权则是真正的美式期权。我们利用 Guo–Obłój 的连续时间对偶理论证明了定价—对冲对偶性，并将对冲简化为二维状态 (X_t, m_t)。在两期模型中，我们建立了凸性引理和继续持有收益的精确分解。
tldr: 本文在鞅最优传输框架下首次对美式固定执行价回望看跌期权进行稳健（模型无关）定价，证明了定价—对冲对偶性，并将最优对冲简化到二维状态 (X_t, m_t) 上。
